info.title: GreenLine Public API
info.description: Deprecated API Documentation can be found here: Version 1.0 # Getting Started GreenLine Base URL: https://integrations.greenline.works/v1/ ##### To use the GreenLine Public API to send an HTTPS request, you'll need to generate your Organization API Key from within GreenLine Organization Settings -> API Key. Please refer to our Knowledge Base API documentation for more information. ##### Once your key has been generated, it can be copied and encoded to be used as your authorization token. # Before you begin ##### All activities that occur using your API Key are your responsibility. Keep your API Key secret. Do not sell, share, transfer, or sublicense them to any other party other than your employees or independent contractors. # **Encode** your API Key for Authorization ##### Generate and send the authorization key with every HTTPS request. Use the API Key you generated and copied from GreenLine API Settings. **Encode the generated API key using Base64 encoding.** ##### Base64 encoding consists of copying your generated API key from GreenLine and applying Base64 encoding. The result is a Base64-encoded key. This is the value you need to pass with every HTTPS request to GreenLine. ##### There are many Base64 encoding tools available online or through a command line interface. If you need assistance, please contact support@greenline.legal. # Provide your encoded authorization key in your request. ### There are 2 options to provide your encoded API key. #### Option 1: Authorization Header ##### Supply an authorization header as part of your request headers with the following format: **Authorization: Basic {encoded-key}** #### Option 2: Query String Parameter ##### Supply the encoded key as a query parameter in your request URL with the format: **{baseUrl}/{apiPath}?api_token={encoded-key}**
